hints.title: Differential Product Gain
hints.text: Incrementing the smallest element x gives the greatest proportional increase to the total product: (x + 1) / x.

hints.title: Priority Queue Greedy Policy
hints.text: At each of the k steps, extract the minimum element from a min-heap, increment it by 1, and reinsert it.

hints.title: Modulo Arithmetic Accumulation
hints.text: After all k increments, multiply all elements together modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Min-Heap Increment Simulation

complexity.notes: Min-heap operations take logarithmic time per increment.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-sorting the array repeatedly to find the smallest number is O(k * n log n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place heapification uses O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that incrementing the global minimum maximizes product growth.
